newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares off lows in late trade, Wall St up.
newsitem.headline: German shares off lows in late trade, Wall St up.

text.p: 1334 GMT - German shares continue to trade lower but rise off their intraday lows in late afternoon as Wall Street opens higher. IBIS DAX over key psychological level at 3,800. No reaction to U.S. GDP data.
* IBIS DAX index down 7.38 points at 3,812.87 points, some 17 points ahead of bourse session closing level.
* September DTB DAX future down eight at 3,839 points.
* Deutsche Telekom slightly ahead amid positive sentiment after shareholder meeting, ex-dividend.
* Auto shares in demand, dollar buoys interest. VW, BMW ahead.
